description: This source file defines the ExcelMatch class, which implements the MATCH function for spreadsheet calculations. It provides methods for searching for specific values within arrays, supporting various match types, and handling string wildcards and type validation.

classes.name: ExcelMatch
classes.description: A class implementing the MATCH function similar to Excel, providing value lookup with support for match types, wildcards, and array inputs.

methods.name: MATCH
methods.description: Static method that performs the lookup operation, returning the position of a value in an array based on the match type.

methods.name: matchFirstValue
methods.description: Private method to find the first occurrence of a value matching criteria, including wildcard support.

methods.name: matchLargestValue
methods.description: Private method to find the largest value less than or equal to the lookup value, considering wildcards and data types.

methods.name: matchSmallestValue
methods.description: Private method to find the smallest value greater than or equal to the lookup value, considering wildcards and data types.

methods.name: validateLookupValue
methods.description: Validates that the lookup value is a number, string, or boolean.

methods.name: validateMatchType
methods.description: Validates and converts the match type parameter to internal constants.

methods.name: validateLookupArray
methods.description: Checks that the lookup array is not empty.

methods.name: prepareLookupArray
methods.description: Prepares and sanitizes the lookup array, converting strings to lowercase and removing nulls if necessary.
